summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, furnishing the Notice of Convocation for its 122nd Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and related proxy materials. This is a routine foreign private issuer disclosure under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a U.S. proxy statement filing, and does not announce any M&A, activism, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The filing contains no terms, recommendations, advisors, structural mechanics, or closing timelines. It is a standard governance notification with no risk-arb angle to watch.
